example_sentences_in_bangla: বৃষ্টিতে ভিজে একেবারে ঢেপঢেপে হয়ে গেছি।
নদীতে পড়ে তার জামা ঢেপঢেপে ভিজে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: I got completely soaked in the rain.
His clothes are soaked through after falling into the river.
history: Originates from the onomatopoeic imitation of the dull sound produced by a wet drum (ḍhāk), common in Bengali rural and cultural contexts.
note: Variants like ঢ্যাপঢ্যাপে are regional pronunciations conveying the same idea.
